steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, places: 1, shop: 1, rods: 1, look: 1, baits: 1, aqua_btn: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1 }; S.coins = 20000; S.pearls = 300; FB.hud.update(); window.__pet = async (id, joy) => { FB.ui.closeAll(); if (!S.owned.includes(id)) S.owned.push(id); FB.shop.equip(id); FB.hud.update(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); if (joy) { FB.person.petJoy = { at: FB.scene.t, n: 2, love: true }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } };

steps.name: питомцы
steps.js: FB.shopUI.open('look'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); document.querySelectorAll('.sheet .tabs')[1].querySelectorAll('.tab')[5].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));
